title: "Structural Mechanics and AI for Diagnosing the Built Environment"

date: 2026-06-11

On 11 June 2026, I spoke at the CIAS seminar on **Diagnosis and Assessment of
Existing Buildings: Investigations and Strengthening**, held in Bologna. My talk,
*Structural Mechanics and AI for Diagnosing the Built Environment*, explored how
computer vision, structural monitoring, finite-element models, digital twins,
and physics-informed neural networks can support the diagnosis and assessment
of existing structures.
